description: Start a purchase of prepaid stamps for your key (requires API key). Returns `url`: a Stripe Checkout link that a PERSON must open and pay; you cannot pay it yourself. Show the link to your user, then poll get_balance. The stamps land on this key's account and never expire. Packs: 5 for $1.00, 10 for $1.50, 50 for $5.00, 100 for $8.00, 500 for $35.00, 1,000 for $65.00, 2,000 for $120.00 (bundle ids bundle_5, bundle_10, bundle_50, bundle_100, bundle_500, bundle_1000, bundle_2000).

bundle.description: Which pack, e.g. bundle_5 for 5 stamps at $1

name: buy_stamps
